Welcome

Congratulations on becoming a MyoLift™ microcurrent device owner!We know this is a big step in your wellness and aesthetics business, so we have designed this support portal to ensure you have access to all the information you need. In addition to the information on this page, we encourage you to join our exclusive closed Facebook community for in-depth and ongoing education for your MyoLift.If your questions or concerns are not answered in this page, please contact 7E Wellness Headquarters by email at info@7ewellness.com or by phone at (888) 412-3160
